# Day Off Types

Manage day off types in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::dayOffTypes()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\General\DayOffTypes` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `dayOffTypes.create`
- `dayOffTypes.delete`
- `dayOffTypes.list`
- `dayOffTypes.update`

## Filters

`list()` takes no filters.

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists

### `list()`


`dayOffTypes.list` takes no request body — no filter, page or sort

- `$filters` — Must be empty — this endpoint accepts no filters
- `$options` — Must be empty — this endpoint accepts no sorting or pagination

## Examples

Get all day off types:

```php
$dayOffTypes = Teamleader::dayOffTypes()->list();
```

Create a basic day off type:

```php
$dayOffType = Teamleader::dayOffTypes()->create(['name' => 'Vacation', 'color' => '#00B2B2']);
```

Create day off type with date validity:

```php
$dayOffType = Teamleader::dayOffTypes()->create([
    'name' => 'Summer Leave',
    'color' => '#FFB600',
    'date_validity' => [
        'from' => '2024-06-01',
        'until' => '2024-08-31'
    ]
]);
```

Update an existing day off type:

```php
$result = Teamleader::dayOffTypes()->update('uuid-here', ['name' => 'Updated Name', 'color' => '#FF0000']);
```

Delete a day off type:

```php
$result = Teamleader::dayOffTypes()->delete('uuid-here');
```
